issuing_body: National Intelligence Agency (NIA) / Ministry of Science and ICT (과학기술정보통신부)
implementation_notes: This guideline operationalizes Article 31 of Korea's AI Basic Act (인공지능 기본법), which imposes three transparency obligations: (1) prior notification that a product/service is operated by high-impact AI or generative AI; (2) labeling that AI-generated outputs were produced by generative AI; (3) labeling of deepfake outputs. The guideline clarifies that transparency obligations fall on the entity directly providing AI products/services to end-users, not upstream model developers unless they directly serve end-users. Foreign operators affecting Korean citizens are also covered. Detailed labeling methods are provided for text, image, video, audio, and other file formats, including both human-perceptible and machine-readable approaches. Artistic/creative works are afforded flexibility in labeling methods.
